title: Bounded etale tensor origin for an open-supported finite-Tor complex
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a map $A	o B$ of finite commutative unital rings annihilated by powers of $\ell$, schemes $U,Z$, and an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites, with exact site comparison $
u_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and open extensions $j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}$ and $j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Let $M$ have bounded intrinsically constructible pro-etale cohomology and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Write $M_B=T_U^{A,B}M$ for scalar extension [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. There exists a bounded etale $A$-complex $L$ with constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and $
u_U^*L\simeq M$. Put $K=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}L$, $N=j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}M$, and $H=K\otimes^L_{A_{Z,\mathrm{et}}}B_{Z,\mathrm{et}}$, regarding $B$ as an $A$-module [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Then $K$ and $H$ are bounded etale $A$-complexes, and there are canonical identifications, relative to $
u_U^*L\simeq M$,
$$
u_Z^*K\simeq N,\qquad

u_Z^*H\simeq N\otimes^L_{A_Z}B_Z\simeq\operatorname{Res}_{A	o B}j_!^{\mathrm{pro},B}M_B.$$
In particular both $K$ and $H$ lie in $D^+$, without assuming $B$ has finite Tor dimension over $A$.

Exact extension by zero preserves this interval, by torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_openImmersionLowerShriek. Transport along supportedComparison and reflect across comparison using torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff. Testing the resulting etale Tor bound on the scalar coefficient sheaf gives HomologyConcentratedIn H a b, hence bounded H. Boundedness gives both bounded-below conclusions. No Tor-dimension assumption on B is used.

Conjugating the two ordinary shriek adjunctions gives open_restrict_mate. Descend the exact square with mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate; the iterated-mate conjugacy identity makes the scalar/open mate invertible. proof.text: The normalized pro-etale scalar/tensor existence-uniqueness theorem is proved by left-derived uniqueness. Form the natural cochain representative arrow by transposing the localized ordinary scalar unit, then apply exact restriction and the termwise composition isomorphism. The exact-right-adjoint K-flat representative theorem makes this arrow invertible on K-flat complexes. The ordinary balancing transformation is exactly the existing sheafExtendScalarsProjection and is invertible. For the tensor functor, Q's lax tensorator followed by the tensor/single comparison is natural and invertible on a K-flat first input, even for nonflat B. K-flat left derivability makes these two functors left derived functors of the same ordinary extension-restriction composite. Functor.leftDerivedUnique gives the desired isomorphism with its equation on every cochain complex. Functor.leftDerived_ext proves uniqueness from that equation. The cochain adjunction-unit formula identifies the constructed representative arrow with the published proScalarRestrictedExtensionRepresentative verbatim.
